verdict.rationale: Sketch documents an official JavaScript API that is "fully supported between releases," with browsable classes and methods. It also ships the `sketchtool` CLI, a `sketch://` URL scheme and a built-in local MCP server, so the product can be driven programmatically. These interfaces run locally around the Mac app, and probes found no OpenAPI or REST spec for the web workspace. missing for 10: a documented remote/web REST API (the OpenAPI probes returned 404), detail on what the 'server applications on any platform' integration actually exposes, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven automation.
